lesson.title: 4.8 Do You...?
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Ask Do you ...? about a daily routine and answer Yes, I do. or No, I do not.
lesson.grammar_function: Do + you + base verb? Yes, I do. / No, I do not. With routine verbs only; no does or he/she questions.
lesson.prerequisite: 3.4 yes/no questions with be; 4.5-4.7 routine verbs.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask Do you ...? and give a short yes or no answer.

accepts.conversational-response: Yes, I do. and No, I do not. are the short answers this lesson teaches; they are complete responses by nature.
